evidence.summary: Public safe Rust API returns ordered per-call results while retaining the compiled artifact/session.
Measured cold artifact compile, retained session open, first call, and 200-call batch.
The test command reuses one compiler session and calls Session::call_batch.

metadata.caveat: The measurements establish retained/batched cost, not standalone subprocess startup savings.

reproduction.instructions: Run the Environment-bound mncs-language:test/language-tests-mncs-embed capability filtered to cold_warm_retained_and_batch_costs_are_reported; inspect Session::call_batch and mncs test batch usage in the exact selected checkout.

summary: The generic safe retained typed batch-call capability is available in mncs-embed::Session::call_batch. The environment-bound cold/warm/batch canary passed: artifact compile 120.673 ms, Session open 6.423 ms, first retained call 0.091 ms, and 200 retained calls in 4.816 ms total (0.024 ms/call). mncs test uses the retained session batch API. This narrows the generic API gap; mncs-doctor remains the affected consumer and has not yet migrated. Standalone mncs call invocations still pay per-process setup.

workaround.description: mncs-doctor still uses its current process-retained runtime; its migration to safe call_batch remains consumer work.
